case_title.quote: SACHIDANAND THAKUR v. UNION OF INDIA & ORS.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was enrolled in the Indian Army in the year of 1978
number_of_accused.reason: Only one accused, the appellant, is tried.

accused_gender.quote: the accused came running towards Naik Jityu Yadav
accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as 'he'/'his', so male.

accused_occupation.quote: was on security duty as the Guard Commander
accused_occupation.reason: Army personnel serving as Guard Commander.

victim_gender.quote: warned him that the person towards whom he, (the accused) was running was one of the members of the Quick Reaction Team and not to fire on him
victim_gender.reason: The victim is referred to as 'him' and 'he', so he is male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased, who was one of his colleagues in the Army

offence_category.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC

statutory_provisions.quote: several other penalties imposable under the Army Act 1950
statutory_provisions.reason: IPC s.302 plus Army Act penalties, with no specific sections given.

weapon.quote: A 7.62 mm Self Loading Rifle bearing butt number 259

evidence_type.quote: witnessed by several Army personnel ... post-mortem examination ... cartridge cases
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery and the remark.

confession.quote: If any doubt still existed ... it stands removed by the remark that he made when apprehended

aggravating_circumstances.quote: despite this warning the appellant fired three shots

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to life imprisonment along with several other penalties imposable under the Army Act 1950

high_court_outcome.quote: repelled all the arguments and dismissed the writ petition and confirmed the findings of the Court Martial
high_court_outcome.reason: Also notes the recall application was dismissed.

final_outcome.reason: Appeal dismissed, so the conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should say the person warning the accused was a fellow sentry who followed, and that PW.14 and the security JCO apprehended the accused, not a sentry.
neutral_facts.quote: followed by Naik Sajimon KT who warned him ... apprehended by PW.14 and the Security JCO PW.6
neutral_facts.reason: Calls the warner a team member and says a sentry apprehended; the judgment says otherwise.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: killing Naik Jityu Yadav at the spot

physical_harm.quote: fired three shots from a distance of 8 to 10 ft. killing Naik Jityu Yadav

number_of_offences.quote: guilty under Section 302 of the IPC

premeditation_planning.quote: the shooting was a deliberate attack of murder
premeditation_planning.reason: Court Martial held it deliberate; no planning discussed.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: fired cartridge cases lifted from the site of the incident also matched the weapon

witness_credibility.quote: no error can be found with the findings of fact recorded by the Court Martial

post_offence_conduct.quote: He was quickly apprehended ... he replied 'MAINE JO KARNA THA KAR DIYA'

trial_duration.quote: On the 6th January, 2000 ... judgment dated 23/12/2005 ... dismissed on 23rd November 2005

investigation_status.quote: the Court Martial before whom the appellant was tried
